# Mail-in-a-Box
> Easy-to-deploy self-hosted mail server software for taking control of email, contacts, calendar, and DNS.

Mail-in-a-Box packages a complete personal or small-business mail server into a simple Ubuntu-based deployment, with documentation for setup, administration, maintenance, and development.

## Project Overview
- [Mail-in-a-Box](https://mailinabox.email/): Project homepage with overview, status, features, and quick links.
- [What is it?](https://mailinabox.email/): Explains the project’s purpose and the services included in the box.
- [What’s inside the box?](https://mailinabox.email/): Summarizes bundled components such as mail, webmail, DNS, contacts, and calendar.
- [How do I get it?](https://mailinabox.email/): Links to setup instructions and deployment requirements.
- [Why build this?](https://mailinabox.email/): Describes the motivation for simple, private, self-hosted email infrastructure.
- [Status](https://mailinabox.email/): Notes current project maturity and operational expectations.

## Setup and Installation
- [Setup Guide](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Step-by-step instructions for provisioning and installing a new Mail-in-a-Box server.
- [Installation Script](https://mailinabox.email/setup.sh): Automated installer for deploying Mail-in-a-Box on a supported Ubuntu server.
- [System Requirements](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Documents supported hosting environment, DNS, and server prerequisites.
- [Domain and DNS Setup](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Covers hostname, glue records, and DNS configuration needed before installation.
- [First Login and Configuration](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Explains initial admin access and post-install setup tasks.

## Administration and Usage
- [Control Panel](https://mailinabox.email/admin): Web-based administration interface for managing domains, users, aliases, and backups.
- [Webmail](https://mailinabox.email/mail/): Browser-based email access included with a Mail-in-a-Box installation.
- [Contacts](https://mailinabox.email/contacts/): CardDAV endpoint and web interface for address book synchronization.
- [Calendar](https://mailinabox.email/calendar/): CalDAV endpoint and web interface for calendar synchronization.
- [DNS Management](https://mailinabox.email/admin): Admin tools for managing recommended DNS records and zone settings.
- [Backups and Maintenance](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Operational guidance for backups, updates, and ongoing server care.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Index](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Primary documentation entry point for installation and administration topics.
- [Help](https://mailinabox.email/): Homepage section linking to support and troubleshooting resources.
- [FAQ and Common Issues](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Practical guidance for common deployment and mail delivery problems.
- [Email Client Configuration](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Instructions for connecting desktop and mobile mail clients.
- [TLS and Security Notes](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Describes certificates, HTTPS, and secure service defaults.
- [Upgrades](https://mailinabox.email/guide.html): Guidance for keeping a Mail-in-a-Box instance current.
